question: How many customers made their first-ever purchase in 2018, counting orders of any status?
sql:
WITH first_orders AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_purchase_ts
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_first_purchase_2018
FROM first_orders
WHERE strftime(first_purchase_ts, '%Y') = '2018'
